candidate91 files are independent. Preserve both previous native warm caches,
every0.90 source/object/raw/generated pair, data indexes, maps/media and protocol.

Planned source scope: a common read-only roster/navigation helper included by
offline HCI's unconditional frame hook and MP quickjs_backend frame hook. Add a

Do not edit native alliance/gift/mute implementations or gameplay callbacks.

Build isolated HCI and spectatorwidgets objects for offline, quickjs_backend and

generic/Campaign/FFA/deferredDuel share0.51 WASM; Towers and MP use their own
pairs. Preserve each exact frozen data package index/name/directory/output hook.
Verify normalized generated program including ASM_CONSTS against raw, all three

Focused source checks must exercise actual roster policy/capability, blind-name
contract, denied fields/nulls, configured/former/spectator slots, scenario discovery,

establish Android presentation. Test exact signed normal91 APK in owned5562 with

Cold reproduction must retain complete native source/bootstrap and copy every
